ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent charges of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact on the state's Medicaid program.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How is the state addressing the issue?
ideas.insight: I believe this story is important because it highlights a significant issue with the Medicaid program in Minnesota. By following the money and investigating the recent charges, we can gain a better understanding of the scope of the problem and how to address it.
